title: Industrial Design Intern
note: Product design consultancy internship; apply by email to info@criadorlabs.com with subject "leManoosh - Industrial Design Intern"; term and pay not stated.

facts.summary: Full-time on-site industrial design internship at a Bangalore product design and innovation consultancy (healthcare, consumer, commercial products).
facts.duties: Concept generation, sketching, 3D modeling, prototyping and model making, design-thinking workshops, materials and manufacturing research, presentations for reviews and clients.
facts.requirements: Current student or recent grad in industrial/product design; sketching, Adobe and CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or Rhino).
facts.apply: Email info@criadorlabs.com with subject "leManoosh - Industrial Design Intern".
